items.name: voice/en/l03_l04/train
items.text:
The locomotive pulls through the yard gate.

The schedule board flips every departure to CANCELLED.

"All services cancelled. Cancellations are regretted."
items.title: The freight line: train

items.name: voice/en/l03_l04/home
items.text:
The recall train is your train home.

Low Water waits beyond the fields.
items.title: The freight line: home

items.name: voice/en/m04_arrival/home
items.text:
Low Water. The same afternoon.

Mara's warning got through. People are packing. The coalition's trucks are still being voted on.

Home has an hour. Get people moving.
items.title: Low Water: arrival

items.name: voice/en/m04_arrival/market
items.text:
Edda keeps the clinic open. Someone is counting raised hands by the tram stop. Someone else needs their charging cable back.

Beyond the awnings, a fan starts.

The notice board is ahead.
items.title: Low Water: market

items.name: voice/en/l04_l05/stairs
items.text:
The habitation court falls quiet. The roof stair is clear.

Neighbours carry what they can. There is no vote left to wait for.
items.title: Up to the roofs: stairs

items.name: voice/en/l04_l05/roofs
items.text:
The water tanks stand above the awnings. The streets belong to the sweep.

The next road out is over the roofs of Low Water.
items.title: Up to the roofs: road

items.name: ambience/low_water_runoff
items.prompt: Quiet courtyard water runoff, a small steady trickle through an old metal street drain with occasional gentle droplets, natural outdoor air, close dry recording, no music, no speech, no dramatic swell, restrained background for a lived-in repair market
